title: LunaSMP Plugin
description: LunaSMP is an all-in-one Paper plugin for SMP and survival servers that puts the most important features in one plugin.
body:
LunaSMP is an all-in-one Paper plugin made for SMP servers that want the most important survival features in one place. It includes spawn, lobby, homes, teleport requests, residence protection, crate menus, and a staff/admin menu with item-giving through a GUI.

Players can use commands like /sethome, /home, /homes, /tpa, /tpaccept, /spawn, and /lobby to make everyday SMP gameplay easier. Staff tools are separated from player features, and the admin menu lets trusted staff manage players through an in-game menu instead of typing everything manually.

Features

Spawn and lobby system
Homes: /sethome, /home, /delhome, /homes
Teleport requests: /tpa, /tpaccept, /tpdeny
Residence protection with selection wand
GUI crate system with keys and rewards
SMP menu for quick access
Staff/admin GUI for player management
Config-based owner/admin access
Built for Paper servers
Perfect for

Survival SMP servers
Private community servers
Small to medium public servers
Server owners who want multiple core features in one plugin
Main Commands

**/spawn, /setspawn
/lobby, /setlobby
/sethome [name], /home [name], /delhome [name], /homes
/tpa <player>, /tpaccept, /tpdeny
/residence
/crate
/smpmenu
/adminmenu**
